label: allmarkets-popsol
_why: One run carrying, at the SAME tick, every ingredient the approach-comparison table needs: per-pop SoL, the markets' order books, and the scenario aggregates. Every approach is then scored strictly within one run, so none is compared against a reference the others did not see.
_note: Tags list EVERY member country of each market, not just the lead, so the per-pop data covers 100% of the pops behind the observed orders - no coverage scaling and no assumption that subjects resemble their overlord. The British market is deliberately absent: its 65 members would pull in all of India, ~15k pop lines in one tick, which exceeds the whole 2.5MB log ring and would be lost irrecoverably.
